№1.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favorite hobby.
№1.sovol_uz: Sevimli mashg‘ulotingiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№1.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№1.jovob_en: My favorite hobby is reading books. I like reading because it helps me learn new words and improve my English. I usually read almost every day, especially in the evening.
№1.jovob_uz: Mening sevimli mashg‘ulotim kitob o‘qish. Men uni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki u yangi so‘zlarni o‘rganishga va ingliz tilimni yaxshilashga yordam beradi. Men deyarli har kuni, ayniqsa kechqurun kitob o‘qiyman.

№2.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your family.
№2.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№2.sovol_en_4: what they do (jobs, hobbies, or activities they like)
№2.sovol_uz_4: Ular nima ish qiladi yoki qanday mashg‘ulotlarni yoqtiradi
№2.jovob_en: There are five people in my family: my father, my mother, my brother, my sister, and me. My father works in an office and my mother is a teacher. My brother likes football and my sister enjoys drawing. In the evening, we have dinner together and talk.
№2.jovob_uz: Mening oilamda besh kishi bor: otam, onam, akam, singlim va men. Otam ofisda ishlaydi, onam o‘qituvchi. Akam futbolni yaxshi ko‘radi, singlim rasm chizadi. Kechqurun birga ovqatlanib suhbatlashamiz.

№3.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your school.
№3.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№3.sovol_en_5: the buildings (for example, football and basketball stadiums)
№3.jovob_en: I study at a big and modern school. My classmates are friendly and helpful. We study and play together. My teachers are kind and explain lessons clearly. Our school has a large building, a library, and sports stadiums. I like my school very much.
№3.jovob_uz: Men katta va zamonaviy maktabda o‘qiyman. Sinfdoshlarim do‘stona va yordam beradi. Biz birga o‘qiymiz va o‘ynaymiz. O‘qituvchilarim mehribon va darslarni tushuntiradi. Maktabimizda katta bino, kutubxona va sport maydonlari bor. Men maktabimni yaxshi ko‘raman.

№4.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favourite holiday.
№4.sovol_uz: Sevimli bayramingiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№4.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№4.sovol_en_5: what you do on that day
№4.jovob_en: My favourite holiday is Eid. I like it because I can spend time with my family. We cook traditional food like plov and sweets. We visit our relatives and say kind words. I feel very happy on this day.
№4.jovob_uz: Mening sevimli bayramim Hayit. Men uni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki oilam bilan vaqt o‘tkazaman. Biz palov va shirinliklar tayyorlaymiz. Qarindoshlarni ziyorat qilamiz va yaxshi tilaklar aytamiz. Bu kun meni juda xursand qiladi.

№5.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your city.
№5.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№5.jovob_en: I live in a beautiful city. There are many markets with fresh fruits and vegetables. The parks are green and clean. Families walk and relax there. There are tall buildings, schools, and shops. I like my city because it is peaceful and comfortable.
№5.jovob_uz: Men chiroyli shaharda yashayman. Bu yerda yangi meva va sabzavotlar sotiladigan ko‘plab bozorlar bor. Bog‘lar yashil va toza. Odamlar u yerda dam oladi. Baland binolar, maktablar va do‘konlar bor. Men shahrimni yaxshi ko‘raman.

№6.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your last birthday.
№6.sovol_uz: Oxirgi tug‘ilgan kuningiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№6.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№6.jovob_en: My last birthday was in July. I celebrated it at home with my family and friends. We ate delicious food and a big cake. My friends gave me presents. We talked, laughed, and took photos. It was a very happy day.
№6.jovob_uz: Oxirgi tug‘ilgan kunim iyul oyida bo‘ldi. Men uni uyda oilam va do‘stlarim bilan nishonladim. Biz mazali ovqat va katta tort yedik. Do‘stlarim sovg‘alar berdi. Bu juda baxtli kun edi.

№7.sovol_en: Write a small essay about a place you like.
№7.sovol_uz: Yoqtirgan joyingiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№7.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№7.jovob_en: One place I like is the park near my house. It is close to my home. There are many trees and flowers. I can see children playing and families walking. I go there to relax and breathe fresh air.
№7.jovob_uz: Men yoqtiradigan joylardan biri uyim yaqinidagi bog‘. U uyimga yaqin. U yerda ko‘plab daraxtlar va gullar bor. Bolalar o‘ynaydi, oilalar sayr qiladi. Men u yerga dam olish uchun boraman.

№8.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your house or flat.
№8.sovol_uz: Uyingiz yoki kvartirangiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№8.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№8.sovol_en_5: What you like about your house/flat
№8.jovob_en: I live in a comfortable house. It has four rooms: a living room, two bedrooms, and a kitchen. My favorite room is my bedroom because I can study and rest there. I like my house because it is clean and quiet.
№8.jovob_uz: Men qulay uyda yashayman. Unda to‘rtta xona bor: mehmonxona, ikkita yotoqxona va oshxona. Mening sevimli xonam yotoqxonam. U yerda o‘qiyman va dam olaman. Uylim toza va tinch.

№9.sovol_en: Write a small essay about yourself.
№9.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№9.jovob_en: My name is Elyor, and I am a university student. I am from Uzbekistan. I am friendly and hardworking. In my free time, I like reading books and learning English.
№9.jovob_uz: Mening ismim Elyor, men universitet talabasisiman. Men O‘zbekistondanman. Men do‘stona va mehnatsevarman. Bo‘sh vaqtimda kitob o‘qishni va ingliz tilini o‘rganishni yaxshi ko‘raman.

№10.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favorite thing.
№10.sovol_uz: Sevimli narsangiz haqida kichik insho yozing.
№10.sovol_en_2: In your essay, you should write about:
№10.sovol_en_4: Who gave it to you or where you got it
№10.jovob_en: My favorite thing is my smartphone. I bought it last year with my own money. I use it to study English and talk to my friends. It helps me in my daily life. I like it because it is very useful.
№10.jovob_uz: Mening sevimli narsam smartfonim. Uni o‘tgan yili o‘z pulimga sotib oldim. Men undan ingliz tilini o‘rganish va do‘stlarim bilan gaplashish uchun foydalanaman. U juda foydali.
